title: Desk Guidance: Installment and Term of a Re-figured Patient Payment Plan Offer
content:
**Calculation.** On a re-figured **Patient Payment Plan** offer, the re-figure balance is the enrolled total; the down payment deducted is the tier's down payment percentage of the re-figure balance, rounded half-up to the cent; the financed amount is the re-figure balance less that deduction; the term used is the offer's number of monthly installments; and the installment is the financed amount divided by the term used, rounded half-up to the cent, never below the offer floor, which is the tier's minimum monthly payment.

**Booking.** The offer is booked with that installment and the term used, except that when the offer floor applies it is booked with as many installments as that floor needs, the financed amount divided by the offer floor and rounded up to a whole installment.

**Order.** The re-figure balance and the share deducted from it are settled first and the deduction is taken from the balance, the term used is the shorter of the terms allowed, and the offer floor is applied last to the divided figure.

### Worked examples (hypothetical figures, a tier with a 10 percent down payment and a 75.00 minimum monthly payment)

| Enrolled total | Deduction | Financed amount | Term used | Divided figure | Booked installment | Booked term |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3000.00 | 300.00 | 2700.00 | 24 | 112.50 | 112.50 | 24 |
| 1500.00 | 150.00 | 1350.00 | 24 | 56.25 | 75.00 (the floor) | 1350.00 divided by 75.00 is 18, so 18 |

On the second row the floor applies, so the offer is booked at the floor and with the 18 installments the floor needs; the final installment absorbs any remainder.
